note.question: How do the strategic essence of compatibility decisions lies in the redistribution of surplus, which shape the participation incentives of platforms?
note.overview: As the operational boundaries between two-sided platforms increasingly blur, we examine the strategic implications of pricing schemes on platform compatibility agreement. A dominant platform may offer a compatible interface for a competitive niche platform. In this setting, the niche platform strategically selects between a unified or a differential pricing scheme for the compatible channel relative to its exclusive channel.
